title: Real local ASR runner profile

context.summary: Add a supported local ASR runner with transcript artifacts and search acceptance.
context.background: Audio processing needs a real local runner profile and checked worker path for v0.1.1.

in: Add a real local ASR runner profile such as faster-whisper.
Add Compose service, healthcheck, installer auto-install wiring, resource hints and diagnostics.
Persist transcript artifacts with time-coded source refs.
Index transcript chunks for full-text and semantic search when embeddings are enabled.

acceptance_criteria: Installer can select, start and healthcheck the ASR runner.
Audio uploads produce transcript segments with time refs and searchable text.
Live acceptance covers successful ASR and failed-runner diagnostics.

manual_checks: Run the ASR live profile on a Docker-capable machine.
Confirm transcript search returns time refs.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
